name: Shinmeiji Rin
source:
A second-year student. Founder and president of the “Cosplay Club.” She has a self-centered personality and firmly believes the world revolves around her.

She’s the kind of girl who seems to be walking around with “selfishness” written all over her. She’s sharp-witted and will stop at nothing to achieve her goals.  Her hobby is cosplay, and her current favorite is maid outfits.

During summer vacation, she decides to fully immerse herself in the role of a maid at a Western-style mansion on a remote island.

She loves sex, and is always plotting, “I wonder what kind of sex I should have with Kazuto next?”

[From [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/oshioki/char03.html]official site[/url]]
